items.title: Blue Chips Pop On Blue Wave As Dow Surges 1,000 Points
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1,009 points, or 1.9%, at Wednesday’s open, according to ABC News. The move came the morning after midterm results showed Democrats taking control of the U.S. House and Senate. ABC News put the S&P 500 and the NASDAQ Composite each up 1.1%. items.title: 3M Reaches $7.35B PFAS Personal Injury Settlement, Maintains 2026 Outlook
items.summary: 3M (NYSE:MMM) said it has reached a settlement to resolve personal injury claims in the aqueous film-forming foam, or AFFF, multidistrict litigation pending in federal court in South Carolina, marking what management described as a significant step in addressing its legacy PFAS-related litigation.

items.title: Is 3M (MMM) Stock Still Cheap After Its $5.8B Settlement?
items.summary: 3M has delivered a very strong 146.9% share price return over the past 3 years, which puts fresh attention on whether the current US$177.05 price is supported by the cash the business can generate. With litigation settlements, capital returns and new product investment all pulling on the same pool of dollars, the question now is how much of 3M's recent performance the underlying cash flows can reasonably carry. items.title: MMM Stock Rises Overnight: Post-It Maker 3M Agrees To $7.4B Chemical Injury Settlement Covering Up To 120,000 Plaintiffs
items.summary: 3M agreed to pay $7.35 billion to settle nearly all existing PFAS-related injury lawsuits.

items.title: 3M Announces $7.4 Billion Settlement in ‘Forever Chemicals’ Injuries Case
items.summary: The agreement covers up to 120,000 plaintiffs who claim they were hurt by chemicals containing PFAS.

items.title: 3M commits $7.35 bln over 9 years to settle PFAS foam injury claims
items.summary: Investing.com-- 3M said on Tuesday it has agreed to settle the bulk of personal injury claims in the sprawling U.S. litigation over PFAS “forever chemicals” in firefighting foam, committing $7.35 billion over nine years.
